name: 25-border-style-all
css: body { margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: "builtin_song"; font-size: 14px; } div { width: 160px; height: 16px; margin: 5px 0; border-width: 4px; border-color: #3366cc; padding: 2px; } .s1 { border-style: solid; } .s2 { border-style: dashed; } .s3 { border-style: dotted; } .s4 { border-style: double; } .s5 { border-style: groove; } .s6 { border-style: ridge; } .s7 { border-style: inset; } .s8 { border-style: outset; } .mix { border-style: solid dashed dotted double; } .hid { border-style: hidden; border-color: #cc0000; }

solid
dashed
dotted
double
groove
ridge
